text:
nina: quick sync: we need a small follow-up on pin TTL semantics + how probe telemetry flows into rollout state. had a few tenant incidents where short TTLs caused unexpected evicts.

chris: can you paste one example? curious if it's TTL vs lease-refresh bug.

nina: example: tenant X had soft pin with lease_ttl=120s. spike in p99 latency -> some agents failed to renew on time -> control plane saw lease_expired and dropped pin, traffic fell back to fallback model. ops couldn't tell if agents were down or just slow.

eva: sounds like we need a grace window plus a probe-derived health signal. what if rollout metadata included: `lease_ttl`, `lease_grace`, and `last_probe_aggregate`? grace acts as extension for transient renew failures.

raj: +1 but careful: we don't want grace to hide real failures. policy: `if last_probe_aggregate.active_clients_pct > threshold AND time_since_last_probe < lease_grace` then treat as healthy. else expire.

chris: that policy works. also, telemetry is noisy; we should store probe aggregates not raw samples. e.g., `{active_pct: 0.87, sample_count: 230, window_s:300}`. no IPs, no traces.

eva: migration note: older rollouts won't have `last_probe_aggregate`. default to `active_pct=0.0` so conservative expire behavior. ops can backfill recent probes if needed.

nina: SDK compatibility: some old SDKs only send a numeric `generation`. add a compact `probe_hint` field: string of the form `g:42|t:1699999000`. control plane will parse when present.

raj: agree. for safety, add `pin_mode` in schema with values `soft|hard|sticky`. semantics: hard = never auto-evict unless explicit unpin; sticky = prefer keep-on-lease-failure until operator confirms.

chris: sticky seems useful for migration maneuvers. but sticky increases resource risk; require a tenant opt-in flag and audit log entry when used.

ci-bot: note: added schema draft to PR #4123 (draft). run `make schema-test` after changes.

nina: Console UX: show a single-line status: `Pinned (hard)` or `Pinned (soft, telemetry-stale)` with a hover that shows `last_probe_aggregate` and `lease_grace` used. ops wants an action button: "Force-hold pin" -> creates an audit entry.

chris: alerting: add rule - if `pin_mode==soft && active_pct < 0.2 && last_probe > lease_grace` -> page on-call. For `sticky` mode page immediately when resource pressure high.

eva: privacy: all probe aggregates must be rounded and bucketed. truncate sample_count to nearest 10 for UI. store exact counts only in internal logs with restricted access.

raj: test plan: 1) unit tests for TTL/grace logic, 2) e2e in staging with synthetic agent jitter patterns, 3) a one-week canary with 5 tenants on sticky to validate resource impact.

nina: good. action items: - chris: add `pin_mode` and `lease_grace` to schema PR, - eva: prepare privacy rules and console mock, - raj: pipeline for backfill script, - nina: coordinate canary. i'll open the PR link here when ready.

ci-bot: reminder: schema PR must include backwards-compatibility note and header version bump `x-rollout-meta-v: 2`.

nina: thanks all. leaving thread open for the PR link. (reaction :eyes:)
